texts.arguments: 5. Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Vivek Rai (supra) has held that High Court in its inherent power if consider appropriate grant exemption from surrendering having regard to the nature and circumstances of the case. It is noteworthy that Rule 48, Chapter X of the High Court of Madhya Pradesh Rules, 2008 makes it mandatory that a memorandum of appeal or revision petition against conviction, except in cases where the sentences has been suspended by the Courts below, shall contain a declaration to the effect that the convicted person is in custody or has surrendered after the conviction.
